I need to consider what the "X-Y Position Indicator for a Display System" refers to.

The X-Y Position Indicator for a Display System was the original formal name given to the computer mouse in Douglas Engelbart's 1967 patent. This device was invented at Stanford Research Institute and was designed to indicate positions on a display by tracking X and Y coordinates.
